designationHistory.indexText: Bayou Sauvage National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1990 in eastern New Orleans under a 1986 act of Congress.

authority.citation: Emergency Wetlands Resources Act of 1986, Public Law 99-645 (Nov. 10, 1986), authorized the refuge

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Bayou Sauvage Urban National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Bayou Sauvage NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan (2009), ServCat 168177: "Bayou Sauvage NWR was established in April 1990"; "on November 10, 1986, the bill establishing Bayou Sauvage NWR was signed into law by President Ronald Reagan" (Emergency Wetlands Resources Act of 1986, P.L. 99-645)

review.note: Authorized by P.L. 99-645, signed by Reagan Nov. 10, 1986; established April 1990 (CCP, 2009).

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Bayou Sauvage Urban National Wildlife Refuge, established in 1990, contains a variety of wildlife habitats, including patches of bottomland hardwood forest; freshwater, brackish and estuarine tidal marshes; lagoons; canals; and natural bayous.
